0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Minebern looks as though he's about to tear his hair out.

24.original: Slay a thistle mole and obtain its fat.

25.original: Deliver the thistle mole fat to Minebern.

26.original: Spread thistle mole oil on the windmill.

48.original: I tell you, this windmill gives me nothing but grief. The damned thing won't stop creaking!

49.original: Putting thistle mole oil on the...moving bits at the top, makes it turn more smoothly, and I'd get up there and do it myself if I hadn't thrown my back out. Not to mention we've used up our supply of the stuff.

50.original: Would you be willing to do it? There's coin in it for you.

51.original: It shouldn't be too hard to find thistle moles around here. Give them a few licks and they'll keel right over. Wringing the fat out is a pain in the arse, though. Once you've got a decent amount, bring it to me.

52.original: Chasing around after thistle moles is not the sort of thing you want to be doing with a bad back, I tell you.

53.original: Now there's a <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> who smells like <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503>'s skinned a mole or two.

54.original: Yes, that ought to do it. Give me a moment and I'll fix up a batch of the oil...

55.original: There you go, all ready. Now, be a good <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403> and climb to the top and spread this on the movey bits. Don't ask me what they're called, I didn't build the bloody thing!

59.original: Good work. I'm not sure if the creaking had any negative effect on the mill itself, but it was bloody annoying!

60.original: I suppose you're wondering what we'd need a windmill for in the first place, seeing as we've no crops to mill into flour. It's actually used for drawing up water from deep underground.

61.original: Of course, if anything were to go wrong, we'd have a serious problem on our hands, and it's my job to make sure that doesn't happen. Anyway, here's your payment. You've earned it.
